title: Support Mode And Break Glass Access Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the support mode break glass access capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: Request approval (workflow waits), approve (completes), then a time-boxed support session audited for the exact target; direct entry creates the same scoped session.

stateModel.description: Workflow status and a scoped session with supportMode flag, effective/target organisation, reason, roles, and a bounded TTL; no standing tenant permissions.

permissions.description: platform.admin.access with a system-admin defence-in-depth role; access is restricted to the matching target tenant FQDN.

contracts.description: Support-session creation and the request/approve support-approval workflow operations.

validation.description: Non-admin, empty/whitespace reason, and empty target are rejected before audit; support-mode without an effective organisation cannot access.

errorModel.description: forbidden, reason_required, and invalid_target outcomes; wrong-tenant FQDN denial; audit failure prevents creation.

auditModel.description: support_session.created is audited before creation and the approval request is audited with workflow state; a failing audit yields no session.

readinessModel.description: Hermetic-domain ready for approval/session semantics; the workflow waits and completes on signal; no external-provider claim.

proof.description: Unit and journey proof of the approval/session state machine. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; author the UI semantic model before generation.
